basic_details.job_title: ACTREC Bronchoscopy Technician Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: A-1 Facility and Property Managers Pvt. Ltd, an outsourced contractor for manpower services (a private employer), is looking for a Bronchoscopy Technician (Pulmonary Medicine) to be placed on contract at Tata Memorial Centre-ACTREC, Kharghar, Navi Mumbai-410 210. Applications are sent by email to [email protected] by 5.30 pm on or before 12 November 2026. The consolidated salary is Rs. 26,630 to Rs. 35,000 per month.

content_sections.heading: About the Employer
content_sections.text: A-1 Facility and Property Managers Pvt. Ltd describes itself in the notice as an outsourced contractor for manpower services. It is recruiting for placement at Tata Memorial Centre-ACTREC, Kharghar, Navi Mumbai. The post is on contract basis through this contractor.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates are requested to email their CV, qualification mark sheet, certificates, experience certificates and a soft copy of the Aadhaar Card to [email protected] . The email must be sent by 5.30 pm on or before 12 November 2026. The notice names no separate application form and prints no subject line for the email.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Diploma OT Technician, Respiratory Therapy Technician, Diploma course in ICU, or Bachelors (or Diploma) in Paramedical Technology from a recognised university; OR Graduate in any field from a recognised university with 1 year experience in assisting bronchoscopy and EBUS. The age limit is 25 - 35 years. The notice says this may be relaxed on experience basis. It prints no date for counting age. Consolidated salary of Rs. 26,630 per month to Rs. 35,000 per month, on the basis of experience over and above the specified eligibility criteria. Duration of engagement: 6 months (extendable as per requirement). The engagement is on contract basis through A-1 Facility and Property Managers Pvt. Ltd. Candidates should check the official notification for any further eligibility detail.

content_sections.text: CV Qualification mark sheet Certificates Experience certificates Aadhaar Card soft copy

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ACTREC Bronchoscopy Technician post?
faq.answer: The email must be sent by 5.30 pm on or before 12 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the qualification for Bronchoscopy Technician (Pulmonary Medicine)?
faq.answer: Diploma OT Technician, Respiratory Therapy Technician, Diploma course in ICU, or Bachelors (or Diploma) in Paramedical Technology from a recognised university; OR a graduate in any field from a recognised university with 1 year experience in assisting bronchoscopy and EBUS.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is 25 - 35 years, which may be relaxed on experience basis.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this post?
faq.answer: The consolidated salary is Rs. 26,630 to Rs. 35,000 per month, on the basis of experience over and above the specified eligibility criteria.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Email your CV, qualification mark sheet, certificates, experience certificates and Aadhaar Card soft copy to [email protected] by 5.30 pm on or before 12 November 2026.

faq.question: Q6. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: An interview is held. Its dates and venue will be informed by email to the shortlisted candidates only.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, it is on contract basis through A-1 Facility and Property Managers Pvt. Ltd, for a duration of 6 months (extendable as per requirement).

faq.question: Q8. Where will the Bronchoscopy Technician be posted?
faq.answer: The post is to be placed at Tata Memorial Centre-ACTREC, Kharghar, Navi Mumbai-410 210.

faq.question: Q9. Does experience affect the salary?
faq.answer: Yes, the salary range of Rs. 26,630 to Rs. 35,000 per month is given on the basis of experience over and above the specified eligibility criteria.

faq.question: Q10. Which documents must be emailed?
faq.answer: CV, qualification mark sheet, certificates, experience certificates and a soft copy of the Aadhaar Card.
